mapper.update: UPDATE legacy_project SET deleted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE media SET deleted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE operation_plan SET deleted_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE media_task SET deleted_at = #{now}, stage = CASE WHEN status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE stage END, status = CASE WHEN status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE status END, finished_at = COALESCE(finished_at, #{now}) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE output_file SET deleted_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_cleanup_job (id, user_id, media_id, scope_key, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{mediaId}, #{scopeKey}, #{status}, 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, media_id, scope_key, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at FROM account_cleanup_job WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'FAILED') AND attempts < 5 AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE account_cleanup_job SET status = 'FAILED', next_attempt_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND updated_at < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'DELETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{mediaId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT probe_started_at FROM media WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{mediaId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT MAX(lease_started_at) FROM media_task WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND media_id=#{mediaId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND run_token IS NOT NULL

SELECT storage_key FROM media WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{mediaId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT o.storage_key FROM output_file o JOIN media_task t ON t.id=o.task_id AND t.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.user_id=#{userId} AND t.media_id=#{mediaId} AND o.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT CONCAT(user_id,'/',id,'-',run_token,'.mp4') FROM media_task WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND media_id=#{mediaId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND run_token IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT CONCAT(user_id,'/',id,'-',run_token,'.mp3') FROM media_task WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND media_id=#{mediaId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND run_token IS NOT NULL

SELECT storage_key FROM media WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT storage_key FROM output_file WHERE user_id = #{userId} UNION SELECT CONCAT(user_id,'/',id,'-',run_token,'.mp4') FROM media_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND run_token IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT CONCAT(user_id,'/',id,'-',run_token,'.mp3') FROM media_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND run_token IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE account_cleanup_job SET status = 'DONE', updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE account_cleanup_job SET status = 'FAILED', updated_at = #{now}, next_attempt_at = #{retryAt} WHERE id = #{id}
